description: openfoam_algorithms/ was copied verbatim from tampines-steam-tables into outram-park-fork-coolprop (uom-only, no openfoam-basic-lib dep). Follow-ups: (1) rename TampinesSteamArray -> OPCP-prefixed; (2) replace its placeholder rho=psi*p correct_thermo with the CoolProp EOS via OPCPFluidSingleCV / flash (state_ph per cell); (3) once wired, drop the module-level #![allow(dead_code)]/unused_imports on the vendored tree; (4) OPCPFluidSingleCV + flashes are single-phase only (no saturation/VLE) — two-phase needs a dome solver (see op-kbc.7).

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
2026-07-08: deleted the other vendored solvers (driftFluxFoam, simplefoam, chtMultiRegionTwoPhaseEulerFoam) at user request — only the EOS-wired rhoPimpleFoam solver + shared openfoam_source remain. Remaining: single-phase only (no VLE), no transport (mu/alphaEff) from EOS, and openfoam_source still has unused primitives (dead_code allow stays until rhoPimpleFoam exercises them).
Scaffolded 2026-07-10: added OPCPFluidArray::correct_transport(&mut self) stub (src/openfoam_algorithms/rhoPimpleFoam/mod.rs) as the EOS-transport wiring hook — documented no-op (#[allow(dead_code)], not yet called from step). Note: the TampinesSteamArray->OPCPFluidArray rename and the rho=psi*p->EOS correct_thermo replacement are ALREADY done; remaining = add mu/alphaEff VolScalarFields + fill from transport::viscosity/conductivity + feed diffusion terms, then drop the vendored dead_code allows.
IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-10: OPCPFluidArray::correct_transport() now populates mu/alpha_h per-cell from crate::transport::viscosity/conductivity (falls back to previous value on None, matching correct_thermo's convergence-failure handling); wired into step() right after correct_thermo(). mu/alpha_h fields already existed and were already consumed by the momentum/energy diffusion terms -- this was the last missing piece. Verified: tests/rhoPimpleFoam correct_transport_updates_mu_and_alpha_h_from_eos test. Bead can be closed.
